title: VictorTaelin/OptMem keeps agent memory in an append-only local log
friendlyTitle: OptMem gives AI agents simple local memory
summary: OptMem is a dependency-free Python tool for persistent agent memory, with about 1,900 GitHub stars at publication. It stores short records in an append-only log, builds a rebuildable tree of summaries and exposes commands to wake, record, search and inspect memory without a background service.
friendlySummary: OptMem saves short memories in a local file and builds summaries so an agent can find older information. It uses one Python script and does not need a background service.
whyItMatters: Agent users can add durable, local memory to systems that support an AGENTS.md or similar instruction file. The transparent files and explicit commands are easy to audit, but users should review the project’s no-license status and avoid recording secrets or unnecessary personal data.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help an agent remember decisions between sessions while keeping the records visible on your computer. Do not store secrets, and check the project’s licence situation before business use.
